bugs_found: compound_interest silently truncates fractional years and compounds_per_year via int(), which can produce incorrect financial results instead of rejecting invalid non-integer inputs
loan_payment silently truncates fractional months via int(), which can produce an unintended repayment schedule
apply_fee only warns on negative amount and still applies fee logic, allowing nonsensical negative payouts instead of rejecting invalid input
fx_convert does not validate that the FX rate is positive, so zero or negative rates can produce invalid conversions
